## Description

Encodes equity universe cointegration adjacency graphs into Maximum Independent Set (MIS) QUBO problems solved via Rydberg atom quantum annealers to select non-correlated trading baskets.

## Where it may fit

Large equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 1000), statistical arbitrage basket selection during high volatility.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, Quantitative Equity Desks.

## Required data

Daily and intraday return matrices, cointegration test p-values, correlation adjacency matrices.

## Caveats

Neutral-atom quantum hardware graph connectivity constraints require independent set reduction heuristics.
